name: visualize
description: Render charts, KPIs, tables, dashboards, and GPT Image analytical visuals to presentation-ready images. Input: JSON data or specification files. Output: PNG/SVG/PDF images sized for presentations (16:9 aspect ratio by default).

actions.name: chart
actions.description: Render a chart from data. Input: JSON with x/y values or series data, via file or stdin. Output: chart image at <output-dir>/chart.<format>. Use when user needs a visual chart from numeric data.

parameters.name: chart_type
parameters.description: Chart type. Values: bar, line, pie, scatter, area, heatmap.

parameters.name: data_file
parameters.description: Path to JSON data file. If omitted, reads from stdin.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image will be written.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Chart title displayed at top.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Visual theme. Values: corporate, modern, minimal, dark, light. Default: corporate.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Rendering backend. Values: delight, legacy. Default: delight.

parameters.name: visual-mode
parameters.description: Delight visual mode. Values: premium_executive, editorial, data_journal. Default: premium_executive.

parameters.name: annotations
parameters.description: Enable smart chart annotations. Default: true. Use --annotations or --no-annotations.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, svg, pdf. Default: png.

actions.name: kpi
actions.description: Render a KPI metric card. Input: value and label via options. Output: KPI card image at <output-dir>/kpi.<format>. Use when user needs to highlight a key metric with optional trend indicator.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The metric value to display. Can be number or string.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Label describing the metric (e.g., 'Active Users', 'Revenue').

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image will be written.

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: Change indicator (e.g., '+12%', '-5'). Colored green/red based on delta-good.

parameters.name: delta-good
parameters.description: Whether positive delta is good. Values: true, false. Default: true. Use --delta-good or --delta-bad.

parameters.name: format-value
parameters.description: Python format string for value. Examples: {:,.0f} for thousands, ${:,.2f} for currency.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Visual theme. Values: corporate, modern, minimal, dark, light. Default: corporate.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, svg, pdf. Default: png.

actions.name: table
actions.description: Render a data table as an image. Input: JSON with headers and rows, via file or stdin. Output: table image at <output-dir>/table.<format>. Use when user needs tabular data as a shareable image.

parameters.name: data_file
parameters.description: Path to JSON file with headers/rows. If omitted, reads from stdin.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image will be written.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Table title displayed above.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Visual theme. Values: corporate, modern, minimal, dark, light. Default: corporate.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, svg, pdf. Default: png.

actions.name: gauge
actions.description: Render a gauge indicator. Input: value and range via options. Output: gauge image at <output-dir>/gauge.<format>. Use when user needs to show progress or status against a target.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Current value to display on gauge.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image will be written.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Minimum gauge value. Default: 0.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum gauge value. Default: 100.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Label describing the metric.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Optional target value to display as a marker.

parameters.name: thresholds
parameters.description: JSON array of threshold objects [{"value": 50, "color": "red", "label": "Low"}] for colored zones.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Visual theme. Values: corporate, modern, minimal, dark, light. Default: corporate.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, svg, pdf. Default: png.

actions.name: dashboard
actions.description: Compose multiple widgets into a single dashboard image. Input: JSON specification with layout and widgets, via file or stdin. Output: dashboard image at <output-dir>/dashboard.<format>. Use when user needs a complete dashboard view with multiple metrics and charts.

parameters.name: spec_file
parameters.description: Path to dashboard specification JSON. If omitted, reads from stdin.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image will be written.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Visual theme applied to all widgets. Values: corporate, modern, minimal, dark, light. Default: corporate.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Rendering backend. Values: delight, legacy. Default: delight.

parameters.name: visual-mode
parameters.description: Delight visual mode. Values: premium_executive, editorial, data_journal. Default: premium_executive.

parameters.name: annotations
parameters.description: Enable smart chart annotations inside dashboard charts. Default: true. Use --annotations or --no-annotations.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution. Values: 1080p (1920x1080), 4k (3840x2160), or WxH (e.g., 1280x720). Default: 1080p.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, svg, pdf. Default: png.

actions.name: image
actions.description: Generate an analysis-rich visualization image using GPT Image. Input: raw JSON data or wrapped payload with data, instructions, and optional typed analysis. Output: raster image plus prompt and analysis audit artifacts. Use when user wants analysis and visualization integrated in a polished image.

parameters.name: data_file
parameters.description: Path to JSON payload/data file. If omitted, reads from stdin.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image and prompt artifacts will be written.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Visualization title override.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Analysis and visualization instructions for the model.

parameters.name: template-image
parameters.description: Optional reference image for layout/style consistency.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Target surface. Values: slide, embedded-card. Default: slide.

parameters.name: analysis-mode
parameters.description: Analysis mode. Values: auto, llm, precomputed. Default: auto.

parameters.name: analysis-model
parameters.description: OpenAI model for typed data analysis. Default: gpt-5.5.

parameters.name: image-model
parameters.description: GPT Image model for raster generation. Default: gpt-image-2.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Image size. Examples: 2048x1152 for 16:9 slide, 1536x1024, auto. Default: 2048x1152 for slide.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Allow a compact title/header. Default: false. Use --header or --no-header.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality. Values: low, medium, high, auto. Default: medium.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, jpeg, webp. Default: png.

parameters.name: dry-run
parameters.description: Write prompt/analysis artifacts without calling GPT Image. Use --dry-run or --generate.

notes: All commands return JSON to stdout with output file paths
Default aspect ratio is 16:9 for presentation compatibility
Themes: corporate (blue/gray), modern (vibrant), minimal (B&W), dark, light
